body_lead: Mumbai News | Maharashtra Cyber Police adopt AI for recruitment process, a first in India In a major leap toward tech-driven governance, Maharashtra Cyber Police will become the first government department in India to use Artificial Intelligence (AI) for screening job candidates. The Mumbai-based cybercrime wing has partnered with a US-based AI firm (VeriKlick) and Nova Strategic Operations (NSO) to conduct initial interviews for hiring 150 cyber consultants.
